title: Finding the Users Active Minutes
summary: Given logs for user actions on LeetCode and an integer k, calculate a 1-indexed array answer where each element answer[j] represents the number of users whose user active minutes (UAM) equals j, for each j from 1 to k.
statement: Given logs for user actions on LeetCode and an integer k, calculate a 1-indexed array answer where each element answer[j] represents the number of users whose user active minutes (UAM) equals j, for each j from 1 to k. User active minutes are defined as the number of unique minutes in which a user performed an action on LeetCode, with each minute counted only once per user.
constraints: Each log is [user_id,minute], and duplicate actions in the same minute count once per user.
Return a length-k array whose index j-1 counts users with exactly j distinct active minutes.
hints: Each user needs a set of minutes to discard duplicate actions.
Group log minutes by user ID, then measure every set size.
Sets exactly encode distinct minutes, and the one-based UAM definition maps size j to zero-based index j-1.
editorial: Sets exactly encode distinct minutes, and the one-based UAM definition maps size j to zero-based index j-1.
